name: Kotis, Sibsig Champion
oracle_text:
Once during each of your turns, you may cast a creature spell from your graveyard by exiling three other cards from your graveyard in addition to paying its other costs.
Whenever one or more creatures you control enter, if one or more of them entered from a graveyard or was cast from a graveyard, put two +1/+1 counters on Kotis.
blocked_sentences: Once during each of your turns, you may cast a creature spell from your graveyard by exiling three other cards from your graveyard in addition to paying its other costs.

needs.what: a cast_from_graveyard permission (affects_spells Creature, static_max_per_turn 1, condition is_your_turn) that charges an ADDITIONAL cost on top of the spell's normal costs -- here {"exile_from_graveyard": 3} of OTHER cards -- so the spell is cast for its mana cost (or any alternative cost) plus the exile, is not escaped, and resolves normally; the per-card analogue of the card-level graveyard_additional_cost, granted by a permanent to other cards
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The cast_from_graveyard static's only extra-price riders are grants_flashback, grants_retrace, pay_life_instead and escape. escape {exile_from_graveyard: 3} has the right price but is an alternative cost that marks the spell escaped (702.138c), so Kroxa/Uro-style 'unless it escaped' and 'escapes with' cards would misbehave and alternative costs could not be combined; grants_retrace discards a land instead; graveyard_additional_cost is card-level and only prices the card's own graveyard cast. The second sentence is expressible (batched permanent_enters with an any of entered_from graveyard / cast_from_graveyard of subject, as Celes does).
